headline: Khaitan advises IRFC on ₹13,527 cr refinancing of Hyderabad Metro Rail
sum: IRFC sanctioned ₹13,527 cr to L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) to refinance existing debt - one of the largest infra financings of the year.
detail: Indian Railway Finance Corporation sanctioned financial assistance of ₹13,527 crore to L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited, inter alia to refinance existing debt. Khaitan & Co acted as lender's legal counsel to IRFC, assisting on deal structuring and financing documents. The funds relate to the 71.16 km Hyderabad metro built on a design-build-finance-operate-transfer (DBFOT) basis.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited has sanctioned a financial assistance of ₹13,527 crore to L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited…” - confirms Khaitan as lender's counsel and the deal structure.

sources.name: Business Standard
sources.blurb: Confirms the ₹13,527 cr term-loan agreement - a 20-year tenure with quarterly repayments, refinancing existing NCDs, CPs and term loans.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.blurb: Adds the credit-enhancement structure: a Government of Telangana guarantee and an RBI-backed direct-debit mandate.
